scenarios.name: hard_delete_preview_is_complete_deterministic_and_read_only
prove: PreviewRfcHardDelete runs under one stable LLD-01 ReadSnapshot and opens no writer UnitOfWork, command receipt, audit or deliberate-proof consumption path
all eleven local guards from algorithms/rfc-hard-delete.json execute exactly once in registry ordinal order and all four cross-domain classifiers use the same stable read authority

manual or purely local provisional creation evidence is eligible only when it is the single valid RFC creation audit; accepted_source_adoption, missing, duplicate or malformed creation evidence blocks
provider status mapping is exact and invalid/exception provider output becomes INDETERMINATE rather than guessed CLEAR
SOMA_RFC_HARD_DELETE_PROVIDER_CLASSIFICATION_V1 tokens are derived only by LLD-03 from provider_id, rfc_id and exact status; provider-private rows/tokens do not cross the boundary
SOMA_RFC_HARD_DELETE_ELIGIBILITY_V1 includes exact RFC identity/revision/archive state/creation context, every local guard status and all four provider classifications/tokens in fixed ordinal order
the implementation reproduces the published eligible_manual_draft_v1 provider tokens and eligibility_fingerprint exactly

blocked and INDETERMINATE previews still return a bounded RfcHardDeletePreviewV1 with exact current fingerprint and ordered typed blockers; they are successful query evidence, not RFC_HARD_DELETE_BLOCKED errors
eligible is true if and only if every local guard and provider status is CLEAR

scenarios.name: hard_delete_execution_is_preview_bound_deliberate_and_exactly_replayable
prove: HardDeleteRfc exact replay resolves before owner preparation/current RFC/provider/proof reads and returns the stored HardDeleteRfcResultV1 even though the RFC row no longer exists
the one-time DeliberateActionProofV1 bearer is excluded from COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 semantic request hashing while rfc_id, base_revision and eligibility_fingerprint remain semantic authority
writer revalidation reruns every local guard/provider classifier and recomputes the exact eligibility fingerprint before proof consumption

LLD-12 proof is consumed only after current state is eligible and the reviewed fingerprint still matches; expected binding is action tickets.rfc.hard_delete, target_type rfc, exact rfc_id, base_revision and eligibility_fingerprint
after proof consumption exactly one outer command receipt exists before the surviving deletion audit/result evidence
ticket.rfc.hard_deleted audit contains only rfc_id, rfc_no, reviewed_revision, eligibility_fingerprint and result=deleted; no challenge id, session/run binding or proof bearer is persisted
the hard-delete audit_event_id is also the sole hard_delete_evidence result id and equals HardDeleteRfcResultV1.hard_delete_evidence_id
only the exact rfcs row is deleted; no relationship/history/dependent cleanup or cascade is attempted

HardDeleteRfcResultV1 is fixed-size deletion evidence containing outcome=deleted, rfc_id, rfc_no, reviewed_revision, eligibility_fingerprint and hard_delete_evidence_id and makes no claim about a current/live RFC revision
same command_id exact replay consumes no second proof, inserts no second audit/result, performs no provider work and never reconstructs response state from the deleted RFC

scenarios.name: hard_delete_closed_guard_registry_preserves_all_history
prove: each local blocker code is emitted from the exact closed registry and ordering in algorithms/rfc-hard-delete.json

any hierarchy edge history, SR relationship history, Device Reference relationship history, current or removed/edited RFC Working Note history, terminal-cascade history or archive/restore history blocks deletion even when no current active relationship remains
any RFC source projection row blocks locally and accepted LLD-04 source provenance also blocks through the source_evidence provider; either authority independently fails closed
any post-creation audit directly targeting the RFC blocks before the current hard-delete audit exists
LLD-05 Task/Objective, LLD-07 Inventory and LLD-09 Communication protected dependencies block without exporting or deleting provider-owned history
a provider INDETERMINATE result emits its closed indeterminate blocker and makes eligible=false
RFC revision must remain exactly 1 and local_archive_state must remain active; archived/restored/corrected/history-bearing RFCs therefore use preservation flows instead
the hard-delete path introduces no total Task/Communication/Inventory/history cardinality cap because it consumes only bounded three-state provider classifications
